updates.text: Posluszny delivered the call with Smith removed and fitted his assigned Under responsibility. The relay held August 1. The record supplies controlled-contact work, not a completed tackle-to-ground sample.
updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

updates.text: All 64 defensive snaps with seven tackles, five solo, and a pressure: the sack of Rivers for 4 on third-and-1 in the third quarter over Rinehart's slot, which forced a punt, the tackle on Brown's 14-yard run to the Jacksonville 13 and on Woodhead's 11 on San Diego's last possession, and the shared tackle on Allen's 38-yard catch. The play-by-play records the tackle and the slot and not the fit or the rush path; the runs on the touchdown drives are Bush's and Crennel's film items with Stone. A minor trunk injury was logged at the end of the first half, at the end of San Diego's two-minute possession; he was not removed and the sack came after it: out, projected return October 3, reassessment September 29 ([medical record](career/2014/Team_Operations/Medical/incidents/paul_posluszny_2014-09-28.md)). No role change follows.
updates.source: Source: [Week 4 game record](career/2014/Regular_Season/Games/Week_04/output.md) and its public receipt. This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

updates.text: Reassessed Monday, September 29, with no change and out of the Monday walkthrough and the Wednesday and Thursday practices, Bush rehearsing the linebacker contingency with Sio Moore, Telvin Smith and the next medically eligible linebackers in the recorded order. Cleared Friday, October 3, his projected date; Stone's packet allows Friday work after an actual clearance within the communicated limits, none was communicated, and he took the Friday practice and the Saturday walkthrough in full. Restored to his base role for Pittsburgh by Stone's decision; no designation on the Friday report. No football finding attaches to the instruction.
updates.source: Source: [Week 5 record](career/2014/Regular_Season/Games/Week_05/output.md) and the [medical history](career/2014/Team_Operations/Medical/medical_history.md#september-29-to-october-4-stanford-phillips-butler-and-posluszny-cleared-poyer-held). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

short.text: Paul Posluszny has been a viable NFL starter at middle linebacker for Jacksonville, dressing for {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games in 2013 and {{2014.regular.games:words}} so far in 2014. He reads the run well, sets the fits, communicates the front and finishes tackles inside. He is stronger working downhill than in isolated man coverage, and his recovery range is limited.

transactions.text: Signed a six-year contract with Jacksonville
